assertions.name: the_PAIRING_FORMULATION_reproduces_the_corpus_bare_element_claim
assertions.source: stable-atom-properties.md asserts the bare 9-crossing element violates Frobenius positivity. Computing (G x)_gamma directly as tr_M(e_gamma . T_w) gives exactly ONE negative channel, ['z_r4'], the two-dimensional lambda = (2,1) block. The formulation reproduces a corpus claim it was not fitted to, which is the evidence that reading (G x)_gamma this way is right -- and it sidesteps the decomposition, which provably does not exist over this basis

assertions.name: NO_two_gluon_crossing_adjunction_restores_proton_stability
assertions.source: crossings <= 2 gives 0 feasible adjunctions; the minimum is THREE, realised by [(0, 1, 1, 0), (1, 0, 0, 1)] = sigma_1 L_+ and sigma_0 L_-. Two blocks assert two crossings suffice, and disagree with each other on the operator: stable-atom-properties.md says the ILP selects 'sigma_0 -> sigma_0 (2 gluon crossings)'; categorical-proton-properties.md says 'a single Hopf link L_- = sigma_1 sigma_0 is the minimum'. Under this predicate neither is feasible. Recorded as a measured TENSION at scope-(a), not a refutation: the predicate is my reading of (G x)_gamma, and one confirmed prediction does not make it the corpus's

assertions.name: N_l_eq_84_is_NOT_reproduced_and_the_filtration_does_NOT_excuse_it
assertions.source: cumulative feasible counts are {0: 0, 1: 0, 2: 0, 3: 2, 4: 6, 5: 12, 6: 19}, continuing 9->65, 10->88, 11->124, 12->157, 13->211, 14->259 in a longer run. 84 falls strictly between the cap-9 and cap-10 values and is hit at no cap. I first recorded the missing confinement restriction as a gap that might explain this. It does not: E(lambda,q) = |d_q(lambda) - 1|/[k]_q! is a closed form, four of the five blocks at k <= 3 are one-dimensional with E = 0 EXACTLY, so there is one distinct nonzero energy, m = 1, and J^1 is the whole algebra. The filtration restricts NOTHING for the proton at k_max = 3, this enumeration was already over the right set, and the miss stands without excuse. Both readings of N_l have now failed: lattice points of decompositions (refuted by the span test) and feasible adjunctions (here)

description: Evaluates Frobenius positivity as tr_M(e_gamma . T_w) >= 0, which needs no decomposition. Reproduces the corpus's bare-element infeasibility; finds the minimum restoring adjunction is THREE gluon crossings, not the two that two blocks assert; and does NOT reproduce N_l = 84.

data.scope: (a) tension recorded; N_l not reproduced; filtration trivial
